whatsNew:
Marking a chat unread now sticks

It used to be forgotten the moment you closed the app, and your other devices never heard about it. It travels with your account now, and opening the chat takes it back.

Links show their picture

A shared link draws the page's own thumbnail. Your phone still never touches the site to get it: we fetch it once, keep our own copy, and the site is never told who was sent the link.

Less data on every message

A message arriving used to make the app re-fetch a hundred messages it already had. About half the data of each received message, gone.

Also

- Group pickers show @usernames again.
- Controls announce their state properly to VoiceOver on the web.

Please check

- Mark a chat unread, force-quit the app, and reopen it.
- Open the same account somewhere else and see the mark there.
- Share a link that has a picture.
- Add someone to a group and check the @handle shows in the picker.
